components.name: jquery-form

supplier.name: M. Alsup (jquery-form project); patched by Jahia

components.description: jquery-form 3.19 with a Jahia backport; the purl names upstream 3.19.0 so that advisories still match.

pedigree.notes: Backport of jquery-form/form PR #586 (huntr.dev bounty by Mik317; same patch re-submitted as PR #611 - both still OPEN/unmerged upstream, so no upstream release contains it): (1) in ajaxSubmit success handler, when fn == 'html' (options.target without replaceTarget) the response is HTML-escaped before insertion: data = $.parseHTML($('<div>').text(data).html()); (2) the fallback parseJSON used when $.parseJSON is missing no longer does window['eval']('(' + s + ')') but logs 'jquery.parseJSON is undefined' and returns null. Coverage: fixes the issue described in jquery-form/form#464 for the default 'html' path; it does NOT sanitize the options.replaceTarget=true path ($(target).replaceWith(data) still receives raw response), and dataType:'script' / javascript responses are still executed via $.globalEval by design. Side effect: HTML responses loaded into a target are now rendered as text (functional change). $.parseHTML requires jQuery >= 1.8.
